segments.text: Listening Test In the listening test, you will be asked
to demonstrate how well you understand spoken English.
The entire listening test will last approximately 45 minutes.
There are four parts and directions are given for each part.
You must mark your answers on the separate answer sheet.
Do not write your answers in your test book.
Part 1.
Directions For each question in this part, you will
hear four statements about a picture in your test book.
When you hear the statements, you must select the one statement that best describes what
you see in the picture.
Then find the number of the question on your answer sheet and mark your answer.
The statements will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.
Now part 1 will begin.
Number 1.
Look at the picture marked number 1 in your test book.
A, a man is pushing a cart, B, a man is opening a door, C, a woman is folding an umbrella,
D, a woman is carrying a box.
Number 2.
Look at the picture marked number 2 in your test book.
A, the people are climbing some stairs, B, the man is leaning over a railing.
C, the people are sitting on a bench.
D, the woman is opening an umbrella.
Number 3.
Look at the picture marked number 3 in your test book.
A, some boats are sailing on the water, B, some crates are stacked near a railing, C,
a bridge spans the water, D, a walkway is crossing the water, B, a walkway is crossing the water,
C crowded with people.
Number 4.
Look at the picture marked number 4 in your test book.
A, the woman is pushing a cart, B, the woman is opening a trunk, C, the woman is tying her
shoe, D, the woman is putting on a jacket.
Number 5.
Look at the picture marked number 5 in your test book.
A, some people are being served,
coffee, B, some people are reading menus, C, some people are stacking chairs, D, some
people are standing at an entrance.
Number 6.
Look at the picture marked number 6 in your test book.
A, some musicians are playing instruments, B, the chairs have been stacked to one side,
C, all of the people are sitting down, D, a car is parked in a garage.
Part 2.
Directions
You will hear a question or statement and three responses spoken in English.
They will not be printed in your test book and will be spoken only one time.
Select the best response to the question or statement and mark the letter A, B or C on
your answer sheet.
Now, let us begin with question number 7.
Number 7.
Who made this dining table?
A, a small workshop out in Portland, B, the maid dusts it every morning, C, yes that
table is on sale now.
Number 8.
Where can I find the floor manager later this afternoon?
A, to mop the floor before we close.
B, no around 4 o'clock, C, she'll be over by the loading dock.
Number 9.
When will the pool open again after the tile repairs?
A, over by the shallow end, B, not until next Friday, C, a spare pair of goggles.
Number 10.
Excuse me, may I take your coat for you please?
A, yes it was on sale.
B, the coat racks over there.
C, of course, here you are, number 11.
Is Nathan taking any more clients this afternoon?
A, the front desk keeps that schedule.
B, a cut and color please.
C, yes it was a warm afternoon.
Number 12.
Where do I collect the day pass I reserved online?
A, just over at the front desk.
B, right after 10 this morning.
C, yes it was already paid.
Number 13.
Isn't this the line for passport renewals?
A, I'd prefer the earliest appointment.
B, they're closed on weekends aren't they?
C, yes you're at the correct window.
Number 14.
Can I take pictures of the artwork here?
A, as long as you don't use the flash?
B, she left it near the entrance.
C, to see the new exhibit.
Number 15.
I don't think our regular customer will like the new sourdough.
A, oh you really think not?
B, about 20 minutes in the oven.
C, because my back's a little sore.
Number 16.
Doesn't the evening sky show start at 8?
A, I already ate dinner.
B, they started running it like that.
C, only during the summer.
Number 17.
Could you pull that customer's car up to the front?
A, it took about 10 minutes.
B, no problem, I'll get it right now.
C, the front tires are new.
Number 18.
Have you finished restocking the linen closet on the second floor?
A, I'd rather start on the top floor.
B, the gift shop closes at 9.
C, not yet, the carts just arrived.
Number 19.
I'll have to change the bindings on these rental skis.
A, everyone agreed on the new opening hours.
B, will he be in the shop tomorrow?
C, yes, that's what the safety inspector wrote.
Number 20.
When would you like to come in for your suit fitting?
A, it's right past the mirrors.
B, I'm only free on the weekends.
C, that jacket fits him perfectly.
Number 21.
When are we heading over to the exhibit hall?
A, as soon as the morning session ends.
B, yes, everyone's already registered.
C, they just painted the back wall.
Number 22.
You realize the large format printer hasn't been serviced in over a year, don't you?
A, the finished prints go on that back table.
B, right, I'll book the technician for this week.
C, could you let Mr. Winters know we're closing early?
Number 23.
How often do the exercise machines here get a full service?
A, for around 20 minutes each.
B, roughly every three months I think.
C, yes, that one's out of order today.
Number 24.
Shouldn't we order more tasting glasses before the weekend?
A, please wipe down the tables before we open.
B, my reading glasses are on the counter.
C, a whole case is being dropped off this afternoon.
Number 25.
How do I reserve a plot for the growing season?
A, there's really no reason to change it.
B, you'll just fill out a form at the office.
C, those tomatoes look ready to pick.
Number 26.
Haven't you confirmed the final guest count with the client yet?
A, around 90 guests, I believe.
B, yes, I settled it with them earlier today.
C, over at the main ballroom.
Number 27.
Where can I pick up the tickets I reserved online?
A, just past the main staircase on your left.
B, the doors open half an hour before the game.
C, they sold out within a couple of hours.
Number 28.
Where's the new touch tank going to be installed?
A, probably next week.
B, you'd have to ask Bernard.
C, the installation looks great.
Number 29.
The microphone in the studio needs replacing, doesn't it?
A, the studio's booked all afternoon.
B, actually, a new one arrived this morning.
C, I'll place them on the shelf.
Number 30.
Should we count the cash before or after we lock the doors?
A, the cash register draw.
B, he fixed the clock earlier.
C, how much is there to count?
Number 31.
Where's the bike with the broken wheel now?
A, I leaned it against the back wall.
B, sure, that would be a big help.
C, because it hit a pothole.
Part 3.
Directions, you will hear some conversations between two or more people.
You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speakers say in each conversation.
Select the best response to each question and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet.
The conversations will not be printed in your testbook and will be spoken only one time.
Questions 32-34 refer to the following conversation.
Hi, I bought this jacket here a couple of months ago, but it feels a bit loose now.
I'd like to have it taken in at the sides.
Of course, we can handle that.
Alterations here usually take about a week, so when exactly do you need it?
My brother is getting married next Saturday, and I'd really like to wear it then.
That gives us just enough time, Mr. Dalton.
Leave me your number, and I'll let you know the moment it's finished.
You can settle the fee when you pick it up.
Number 32.
Why most likely is the man visiting the shop?
Number 33.
What does the woman imply about the alterations?
Number 34.
What does the woman offer to do?
Questions 35-37 refer to the following conversation.
Have you checked the registration list for tonight's wine tasting?
Nearly 40 guests have signed up.
Our biggest turn out yet.
Impressive, but the tasting room's capacity is only about 25,
so it'll get uncomfortably crowded in there.
You're right.
Let's relocate the whole event out to the courtyard, where there's plenty of space.
Good thinking.
I'll set up the chairs and tables out there this afternoon.
Perfect.
That's a big help.
And afterward, we're leading everyone out among the vines to watch the harvest.
Sounds lovely.
What time does that part get going?
The tasting wraps up around 7.
And that's exactly when the vineyard walk begins.
Number 35.
Where does the conversation most likely take place?
Number 36.
What does the man volunteer to do?
Number 37.
What will take place at 7 o'clock?
Questions 38-40 refer to the following conversation.
Bianca, do you know which room was reserved for next week's staff training?
I need to check the details.
Yes, conference room 2.
But there's a problem.
It only seats 20 and 35 people have signed up.
That won't fit everyone.
Let's use the large room on the fourth floor instead.
It's free that day.
The only issue is it has no projector or microphone.
Good idea.
I'll take care of printing the extra handouts.
But only the facilities department can install that equipment
and they need a day's notice.
Right.
And the training is on Monday.
I'd better handle that part today then.
Perfect.
Then we'll be all set for next week.
Number 38.
What does the man ask about?
Number 39.
What does the woman offer to do?
Number 40.
What will the man most likely do next?
Questions 41 through 43 refer to the following conversation.
Good morning.
This is Colton Reeves.
I lead several photography workshops at the Westbrook Adult Learning Center.
I'm calling to propose adding a new evening course next term.
Hello Colton.
I'm Sylvia Warren, the program coordinator.
That sounds interesting.
What did you have in mind?
A beginner digital photography class.
Enrollment in similar courses has been strong.
So I'm sure we'd fill the seats.
Promising.
But new courses need curriculum committee approval first.
Could you send me a course outline by Friday so I can pass it along for review?
Of course.
I'll email it this afternoon.
Number 41.
Who most likely is the man?
Number 42.
Why does the man call the woman?
Number 43.
What does the woman ask the man to do?
Questions 44 through 46 refer to the following conversation.
Hi.
I'd like to order 14 grave trophies for our youth football tournament next month.
Could they be ready by the 15th?
Sure.
I can help with that.
Unfortunately, our engraving machine is being serviced all this week,
so the standard two-week turnaround won't work.
I can offer rush service for an extra fee instead.
That's fine.
Let's go with the rush service.
What do I need to pay to secure the order today?
Number 44.
According to the woman, what are the items being ordered for?
Number 45.
What does the man say about the shop?
Number 46.
What does the woman agree to do?
Questions 47 through 49 refer to the following conversation.
Hi.
I came to several shows at the Belmont Playhouse last year,
and now I'd like to sign up for the full season instead of buying individual tickets.
Wonderful.
We offer two annual packages.
The reserved package keeps the same seats every night,
while the flexible package lets you exchange dates whenever your schedule changes.
That matters to me.
I travel a lot for work, so I can't commit to fixed evenings,
and don't want to waste shows I've paid for.
Then the flexible package suits you best.
Fill out this sign-up form with your details first,
and once you've paid, I'll set up your subscriber account online.
Number 47.
What does the woman want to do?
Number 48.
What does the man recommend?
Number 49.
What will the woman most likely do next?
Questions 50 through 52 refer to the following conversation with three speakers.
Hello, and welcome to Calvat and Studios.
How can I help you two today?
Hi there.
We're here to attend the taping of the midday cooking show.
Wonderful.
Before I let you through, could I see your booking confirmation, please?
Of course.
Here's the email with our confirmation number.
Should we head straight into the studio?
Almost.
The doors open at 11.30.
In the meantime, I'd recommend downloading our studio app.
It shows your seat updates, today's full schedule, and a map of the parking lot.
Number 50.
Why are the men at the studio?
Number 51.
What does the woman ask the men to provide?
Number 52.
What does the woman recommend the men do?
Questions 53 through 55 refer to the following conversation.
Good morning.
I dropped my tablet last week.
The screen is cracked and it's completely unresponsive now.
I'm sorry to hear that.
A screen replacement runs about $80 and takes roughly three days.
Three days.
I use it for all my delivery work, so I really can't be without one that long.
In that case, I'd recommend our loaner tablet while yours is being fixed.
There's a small refundable deposit.
And how do I get that deposit back?
It's returned to you as soon as you bring the loaner back and pick up your repaired tablet.
Great.
Let's set it up.
Number 53.
Why is the man visiting the business?
Number 54.
What does the man imply when he says, I really can't be without one that long?
Number 55.
What does the woman say about the deposit?
Questions 56 through 58 refer to the following conversation.
Good afternoon.
Welcome to Meadowcrest Motors.
I'm Colin.
How can I help you?
Hi.
I noticed your advertisement in the weekend paper.
And I'd love to come try out the Trailmark SUV that's featured in it.
Would that be possible?
Certainly.
That model has been in high demand lately, so I only have two left on the lot right now.
Its cargo space is what most people mention.
That's exactly what I'm after.
My family and I are driving out to the coast next month.
And our current car is just too small for all our luggage.
I understand completely.
Once you've had a chance to drive it, I can connect you with our finance team to walk through
the monthly plans.
Number 56.
Where does the man most likely work?
Number 57.
Why does the woman want a new vehicle?
Number 58.
What does the man offer to do next?
Questions 59 through 61 refer to the following conversation with three speakers.
Okay.
Before we finish up, I want to plan out who's covering our maintenance shutdown next week.
The whole plant goes offline while the crew services the production lines.
Sounds good.
How many of us do you need on hand that day?
It's set for Thursday, and I'll need at least four people from our line to help the maintenance crew.
Hold on.
Thursday?
We've got an ingredient delivery coming in that same morning.
Someone has to be here to receive it.
Oh, you're right.
We can't have both at once.
Devon, can you get in touch with the supplier and see if they'll move the delivery to Friday?
Sure, I'll call Ashby ingredients first thing tomorrow and ask them to reschedule.
Number 59.
What are the speakers getting ready for?
Number 60.
What problem does one of the men point out?
Number 61.
What does Devon say he will do?
Questions 62 through 64 refer to the following conversation and price list.
Hi, is this Stonebridge aggregates?
I'm putting in a new patio out back where our old flower bed used to be, and I'll need some crushed stone for the base.
Do you deliver?
Yes, we deliver right across the area.
How much stone are you thinking?
Well, the patio's about 300 square feet, so I figure I'll need around 3 tons.
Let me check our rate card.
Okay, I've got the price right here.
And good news, delivery is free on any order over 2 tons, so yours qualifies.
Great, and will 3 tons really be enough to cover the whole space?
It should just about, but stone always settles once it's laid, so I'd order a bit beyond what you need.
Otherwise, you risk coming up short and paying for a second delivery.
Number 62.
Why does the woman need the crushed stone?
Number 63.
Look at the graphic, how much will the woman's order cost?
Number 64.
What does the man recommend the woman do?
Question 65 through 67 refer to the following conversation and list.
We've got about 20 minutes before the race begins, so let's do one last check of our stations.
Sounds good.
The turnout is incredible this year.
All the registration fees go to the children's hospital.
I printed out the station assignments this morning.
Here, take a look at the sheet.
Thanks.
I'll be making sure the runners have something to drink as they reach the midway point.
Perfect.
And a local shop dropped off all the printed route maps yesterday, so every marshal will have one.
Number 65.
What type of event are the speakers preparing for?
Number 66.
Look at the graphic, who most likely is the woman.
Number 67.
According to the man, what happened yesterday?
Question 68 through 70 refer to the following conversation and list.
Hi, I'm looking for a bracelet as a graduation gift for my niece, and I'd like it engraved with her name.
Wonderful.
All of our handmade designs can be engraved.
Did you have a particular style in mind?
Something simple or more decorative?
Something elegant.
But my niece's ceremony is this Saturday, so I really need it finished before then.
Is that possible?
Let me check.
The decorative piece by Lucas Berg won't be ready until next week.
But the elegant design by Diane Whitlock is in stock, and we can engrave it today.
I'll bring it out.
Number 68.
Where most likely are the speakers?
Number 69.
What is the woman concerned about?
Number 70.
Look at the graphic, which design does the man recommend?
Part 4.
Directions.
You will hear some talks given by a single speaker.
You will be asked to answer three questions about what the speaker says in each talk.
Select the best response to each question, and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your
answer sheet.
The talks will not be printed in your testbook, and will be spoken only one time.
Question 71 through 73 refer to the following excerpt from a meeting.
Thanks for coming everyone.
I've called this short meeting to share some exciting news.
Next month, our firm will have a booth at the Regional Home Improvement Exhibition downtown.
As you know, our repair and remodeling services rarely get this kind of visibility, so this
is a great chance to meet homeowners who need our help.
The event runs three full days, so I'll need several of you to help staff the booth.
To help me plan the schedule, please mark the days you're available on the sign-up sheet
in the break room before Friday.
Number 71.
What type of business does the speaker most likely work for?
Number 72.
What good news does the speaker announce?
Number 73.
What are the listeners asked to do before Friday?
Question 74 through 76 refer to the following advertisement.
Thanks so much for stopping by the demonstration here at Brightwater Kitchen Shop, where I'll
be showing off our newest blender.
It does a lot of things well, but the feature I'm proudest of is how it breaks down a full
tray of ice in just a couple of seconds.
And this week only, you can take 20% off the purchase price.
Keep in mind, though, that discount is for store members only.
Before you go, please sign up for one of our free cooking classes using the tablet by the
register.
Number 74.
What does the speaker say she likes most about the blender?
Number 75.
What is required in order to get the discount?
Number 76.
What does the speaker encourage the listeners to do?
Question 77 through 79 refer to the following telephone message.
Hi, this is Melanie Grant from Crestwood Facilities, following up on the office cleaning your
company arranged with us last week.
I'm pleased to confirm that our cleaning team will make its first visit next Tuesday evening
after your staff leave.
Before then, could you let us know how our crews should get into the building after everyone's
gone home?
There won't be anyone at the security desk after six to let them in.
I should also mention that we're fully booked all next week, and our next open evening isn't
until months end.
So please get back to me as soon as you can.
Thanks.
Number 77.
Who most likely is the speaker?
Number 78.
What does the speaker ask the listener to provide?
Number 79.
What does the speaker imply when she says we're fully booked all next week, and our next
open evening isn't until months end?
Questions 80 through 82 refer to the following speech.
Good morning, and thank you to the officials and reporters gathered here as we cut the
ribbon on our new facility in Fairhaven.
The organization I represent is not a private operator, where a taxpayer-funded agency overseeing
rail and bus service across the region.
This station links downtown with the northern communities, part of a plan to run trains
every 15 minutes by next spring.
To introduce residents to the line, every fare on this route will be waived all week.
So rather than watch from the platform, I encourage you to climb aboard and ride the route yourselves.
We look forward to serving this community for years to come.
Number 80.
Where most likely is the talk being given?
Number 81.
What type of organization does the speaker represent?
Number 82.
What does the speaker encourage listeners to do?
Questions 83 through 85 refer to the following speech.
Good morning everyone, and thank you all for coming to this month's all-staff assembly
here at Danforth Manufacturing.
I'm very pleased to announce that we're launching a brand new mentorship program starting this month.
Here's how it will work.
Each of our newer employees will be paired with a more experienced member of staff.
The main benefit is that you'll receive personal guidance from a seasoned colleague
throughout your first months on the job.
If you'd simply like to hear more first, we'll hold a brief information session next Wednesday.
But if you'd like to take part, whether as a mentor or as a mentee,
please sign up on the company website by this Friday.
We really look forward to seeing you all get involved.
Number 83.
What is the main purpose of the speech?
Number 84.
What does the speaker say is the main advantage of the program?
Number 85.
According to the speaker, what should employees do to enroll in the program?
Questions 86 through 88 refer to the following talk.
Good evening, and thank you for signing up for tonight's public stargazing program at Glenmore Observatory.
No experience with astronomy is needed, so just relax and enjoy the view.
Please pick up a red flashlight at the front desk and dress warmly since it gets cold outside.
We'll begin indoors with a short introductory presentation.
Then we'll move to the deck, where our guides will help you find planets and constellations through the telescopes.
Before you leave, each of you will receive a booklet mapping the night sky to keep.
Number 86.
Who most likely are the listeners?
Number 87.
What will the group do outside?
Number 88.
What will happen at the end of the evening?
Questions 89 through 91 refer to the following advertisement.
Good afternoon listeners, and thank you for tuning in.
Here's some exciting news for every homeowner in town.
Havenbrook Appliances is celebrating 25 years in business.
To mark the occasion, we're holding our big anniversary weekend sale on Saturday, June 21.
You'll find up to 40% off refrigerators, washing machines, ovens, and much more.
And here's the best part.
Every purchase you make that day automatically enters you to win our grand prize, a state-of-the-art home espresso machine.
Now remember, last year the best deals were gone by lunchtime, so visit us bright and early at our showroom on Larkmore Avenue.
We can't wait to see you there.
Number 89.
What event is the business promoting in June?
Number 90.
What can listeners win by taking part?
Number 91.
What does the speaker imply when he says, last year the best deals were gone by lunchtime?
Questions 92 through 94 refer to the following broadcast.
Good morning, and welcome to Local Business Spotlight on Harborview Community Radio.
I'm your host, Carol Denning.
This week we're featuring Hailwoods, a family business where residents have bought their guitars, violins, and printed scores for over 30 years.
The owners tell me they've just relocated a few doors down to a roomier storefront with space for two new soundproof practice rooms.
They've also launched a program of small group classes aimed at those picking up an instrument for the very first time.
So if that describes you, drop by this Saturday, when instructors will run a complimentary trial class, just visit the store's website first to reserve one of the limited places.
Number 92.
What kind of business is being profiled?
Number 93.
What has the business recently begun to provide?
Number 94.
According to the speaker, what can listeners do this Saturday?
Questions 95 through 97 refer to the following tour information and map.
Good morning everyone, and welcome to Larkhaven Studios.
I'm your guide, Nadia Brooks, and I'm glad the whole group has gathered here at the main entrance.
We'd plan to show you five buildings, but the editing suites are closed today for a private screening, so we'll walk through the four on your map instead.
We'll begin at the building that borders the visitor parking lot, so please follow me that way.
Later this afternoon, you'll watch a live stunt demonstration performed by our professional crew.
Before we head inside, I'd ask everyone to silence your phones, since filming may be underway.
Alright, let's get started.
Number 95.
Look at the graphic, where will the tour begin?
Number 96.
What will the visitors do this afternoon?
Number 97.
What does the speaker ask the listeners to do before going inside?
Questions 98 through 100 refer to the following excerpt from a talk and map.
Good morning everyone, and welcome to Opening Day here at the Riverbank Green Market.
The gates won't open to the public for another hour, so let's get you settled first.
Your group has been assigned to the plant nursery, which sits in the far corner of the grounds,
so please head over that way to set up your stalls.
Now, a market inspector will be coming through at 10 o'clock to check that everyone's permits are properly displayed,
so make sure those are up before then.
And before I open the gates, I'll come around to collect your signed vendor agreements, so please have them ready.
Number 98.
Look at the graphic, which lane should the listeners take?
Number 99.
According to the speaker, what will happen at 10 o'clock?
Number 100.
What does the speaker say he will do next?
